milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the iron block (within 5 blocks of its position at spawn-relative [10, 1, 10]) and be facing toward it (within 60 degrees), which models 'the player has found and is observing the iron block'. This is the preferred rule type for find tasks per the design guidelines.
